manifest_intro: More and more people are realizing: Politics as it's currently being done can't continue. Many problems are getting bigger instead of smaller - no matter which party is in power. This isn't just about individual decisions, but about the whole system reaching its limits.
manifest_action: Our system is based on exploitation and unlimited growth. We stand for real solutions instead of symbolic politics.
imperialism_intro: The root of evil: Why we must break the global dominance of the USA. US imperialism is not the 'world's policeman', but the greatest robber of our era.
headscarf_intro: State coercion, justified by nothing but gut feeling. Instead of solutions, the government offers symbolic politics - racist and divisive.
law_intro:
Law and justice are written proposals for non-harmful behavior.
But as long as no power can enforce them, they are not worth the paper they're written on.
Justice only emerges when equal rights apply to all and violations lead to effective sanctions.
